rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says that a part of the process is repeated until a check is made, and that the check either sends the flow back to repeat that part or moves on to a later step or ends the process: Model the repeated part as a loop. Place an exclusive merge gateway before the first element of the repeated part, so that the entry flow and the return flow both join there. Place the check after the repeated part as an exclusive decision gateway. One outgoing flow of the decision returns to the merge gateway for another pass, and the other leads to the next step the description names or to an end event if the description says the process stops there. Ensure every merge gateway inside the cycle has a path to an end event. Do not connect the check directly back into the repeated part without a merge gateway, and do not run the repeated part once and move on without the loop.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that a part of the process is repeated until a check is made, and that the check either sends the flow back to repeat that part or moves on to a later step or ends the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an action that is a step of the process, such as communicating an outcome to another party or collecting feedback from a party, and that action happens on only one branch of a decision or after the main work is done: Model each such performed action as a task, placed on every branch where the description states it occurs and in the order the description gives. Do not replace the performed action with an intermediate throw or catch event. Reserve intermediate events for occurrences the process waits for or reacts to.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a separate party must itself perform a step on an item it received, such as confirming receipt of something sent to it or rating it, and the description states this as an obligation of that party rather than as an occurrence the process reacts to

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that after two parties exchange ratings, whether the process continues (or which later branch is taken) depends on whether a rating is at or below a given threshold: After the join that completes the exchange of ratings, model an exclusive gateway whose outgoing sequence flows carry the mutually exclusive outcomes (threshold met or not). Each outcome gets its own conditional flow leading to the branch the description assigns to it, and the flows are not left unconditional.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that after two parties exchange ratings, whether the process continues (or which later branch is taken) depends on whether a rating is at or below a given threshold

rules_sent_back.instruction: Distinguish message tasks from message events: a task models performed work; an event models a message occurrence affecting flow.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a participant (such as another party) must itself confirm receipt of something it got or give a rating or evaluation of it, as a step of the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a decision whose outcome depends on a rating or measured value being at or below (or above) a stated threshold, and the outcome changes which branch the process takes: Model the decision as an exclusive gateway labeled with the comparison as a yes/no question that uses the threshold and the measured subject exactly as the description states them, and give each outgoing flow the matching outcome. Do not replace the stated comparison with a generic label such as the name of a later state.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states a decision whose outcome depends on a rating or measured value being at or below (or above) a stated threshold, and the outcome changes which branch the process takes
